subject: Learning Methods
title: Flow and Time Distortion
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Flow and Time Distortion.

hook.text: A surgeon operates for six hours but swears it felt like one. Time perception bends during deep absorption.

buildup.text: In flow, the brain reduces activity in the area that tracks time. Your internal clock slows or stops.

discovery.text: Without time awareness, you commit fully to the present moment. No past regrets, no future worries. Just now.

twist.text: Time distortion means you can accidentally skip meals or sleep. Flow is powerful but needs external boundaries.

climax.text: Set an alarm before entering deep work. Let the timer handle time so your mind can forget it entirely.

punchline.text: In flow, time vanishes. Set an alarm as a safety net.

quiz.question: Why does time seem to fly during flow?
options: You are more productive so tasks finish faster
The brain reduces activity in the time-tracking area
Flow only occurs during short tasks
